verdict.rationale: All evidence describes PayPal's agentic checkout flows (ACP/UCP, Store Sync, cart create/get APIs) which are shopping-cart/checkout-session protocols for AI assistants buying products — none of it describes HTTP 402 'Payment Required' machine-to-machine micropayments for per-call API monetization without a checkout UI. The cart APIs explicitly involve a checkout/cart session (createcart, getcart, complete_checkout) rather than a stateless 402 challenge-response payment per request.
